sections.note: Reframed the abstract root-finding problem as spring equilibrium and force balance for a mechanical engineering audience.
Kept the tangent-line derivation and simple-root condition while linking them to a mechanical residual and its slope.
Retained the local convergence statement and clarified its meaning in the context of a physical spring response.
Kept the step and residual tests and added a short explanation of why both are useful in engineering calculations.
Preserved the damping rule and failure boundaries while tying them to physically realistic spring responses and starting guesses.
Connected the mathematical rules to a compact Python implementation and exercises that reinforce the same logic.

source_issues.issue: The source notes are general and do not include a mechanical engineering application, so the lesson uses a discipline bridge and a concrete spring example without changing the core mathematical content.
